title: Chatbot
seoTitle: What Is a Business Chatbot? Types, Costs and Limits
seoDescription: A chatbot answers customer or staff questions automatically on your website or WhatsApp. Rule-based vs AI chatbots, costs, accuracy and handover to people.
summary: A chatbot is software that answers questions and completes simple tasks through chat, on a website, WhatsApp or an internal tool. Modern AI chatbots answer from your own documents and data, and hand the conversation to a person when they are unsure or the customer asks.

dataPoints.label: Types
dataPoints.value: Rule-based menus, AI chatbots answering from documents (RAG), and AI agents that also take actions

dataPoints.label: Channels
dataPoints.value: Website widget, WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, internal portals

dataPoints.label: Typical first use
dataPoints.value: Answering routine questions about orders, policies, admissions or products

dataPoints.label: Must-have
dataPoints.value: A clear route to a human and logs of every conversation

body:
## Rule-based or AI

Rule-based bots follow fixed menus: predictable but rigid. AI chatbots understand free text and answer from your material, which handles far more questions but needs grounding and testing. See [how to build an AI chatbot trained on your company documents](/blog/how-to-build-an-ai-chatbot-trained-on-your-company-documents).

## Measuring success

Track questions resolved without a person, handover rate, wrong answers found in review, and customer satisfaction.

faqs.a: Not if it answers quickly, admits what it does not know and hands over to a person easily.

faqs.q: Can a chatbot answer in Hindi?
faqs.a: Yes. AI chatbots can handle Hindi and mixed Hindi-English, though you should test with your real customer questions.
